description: This Java class 'DataVolume' defines data volume limits and associated metadata within the 'org.eclipse.hono.util' package. It includes properties such as effectiveSince, maxBytes, and period, along with their getters and setters, and uses annotations for JSON serialization and validation.

classes.name: DataVolume
classes.description: Represents data volume constraints for a tenant, including effective timestamp, maximum bytes allowed, and the period over which the data volume applies.

methods.name: getEffectiveSince
methods.description: Returns the timestamp indicating when the data volume limit came into effect.

methods.name: setEffectiveSince
methods.description: Sets the timestamp indicating when the data volume limit came into effect, returning 'this' for fluent API usage.

methods.name: getMaxBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of bytes allowed for the specified period.

methods.name: setMaxBytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes allowed, with validation against negative values, returning 'this'.

methods.name: getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period over which the data volume limit is applicable.

methods.name: setPeriod
methods.description: Sets the data usage period, returning 'this' for chaining.
